6200 business miles in Jan. 1 - June 30, 2026 at 72.5 cents = $4,495.00; 5800 business miles in July 1 - Dec. 31, 2026 at 76 cents = $4,408.00. Total $8,903.00. 2026 has two business rates: 72.5 cents before July 1 and 76 cents from July 1 (Announcement 2026-11).

Rates from IRS and GSA publications. General information, not tax advice.

notes: Employees cannot deduct unreimbursed business mileage as an itemized deduction (made permanent by the One, Big, Beautiful Bill Act); self-employed people deduct it on Schedule C, and employers can reimburse it tax-free at these rates.
